risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures discretionary consumer stocks, and earnings in 37 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), weak technical confluence (price below 50/200 EMA, stochRSI overbought, primary MACD negative), no fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 37 days create unacceptable risk/reward.
